question: According to dietary guidelines recommended by physicians, the RDA for cholesterol intake in healthy adults and children over four years of age. (RDA) is ________ mg/day.
solution:
The correct answer is __**300.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **recommended daily intake of cholesterol **for adults and children over four years of age, according to the guidelines provided by healthcare professionals, is** RDA 300mg/day.**
 
• Cholesterol is an essential component of cell membranes and is also involved in the production of** hormones, vitamin D, and bile acids.**
 
• High levels of cholesterol in the blood can increase the risk of **heart disease and stroke.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cholesterol **is a** type of fat **that is produced by the** liver** and is also found in certain foods such as** meat, dairy products, and eggs.**
 
• **HDL (high-density lipoprotein)** cholesterol is often referred to as** "good" cholesterol** as it helps to remove excess cholesterol from the blood and carry it back to the liver for processing.
 
• **LDL (low-density lipoprotein)** cholesterol is often referred to as **"bad" cholesterol** as it can build up in the arteries and increase the risk of heart disease and stroke.
 
• **Eating a healthy diet, exercising regularly, and maintaining a healthy weight** can all help to reduce cholesterol levels and lower the risk of heart disease and stroke.
